title: Wasalt - overview of public sitemap catalog
text: Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is a Saudi Arabian online real-estate marketplace. Its public English sitemap lists 60,000 individual property listings (45,389 for sale, 14,611 for rent), 8,330 search/category pages by property type, city and neighbourhood, and static pages (privacy-policy, wasalt-business, masterplan, terms-n-conditions-for-ewallet, terms-n-conditions-for-auction, terms-and-conditions, terms-of-advertising, terms-of-use, home). Source: Wasalt public sitemaps (cdn.wasalt.sa/sitemap). Counts reflect the sitemap snapshot and are not live inventory.
